subject: Proposal: Prepay + Ramp Credits for Nimbus — options and ask
messages:
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Patel <sam.p@nimbus.ai>
Cc: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: prepay + ramp credits — quick ask and options

Sam — great talking this morning. As discussed, I’m sending a short note with options that balance Nimbus’s cash cadence with predictable unit economics. We want to make sure you get the headroom during launch months while keeping total spend aligned to product roadmap.

Summary (high level):
- Option A — 12mo prepay: $120k prepay, comes with 60% credit (token credit pool) in month 1–3, then 10% effective top-up in months 4–12. No term discount.
- Option B — 18mo split-prepay: $180k committed over 18 months paid up front or split 60/40 at signing/6mo; includes 40% launch credits and 10% year-over-year unit price discount after month 12.
- Option C — 24mo multi-year: $320k upfront, 15% term discount, larger reserve for peak usage.

Questions for you: what cadence works for procurement? Any hard constraints on prepay timing or PO terms? If 12mo is the only option, we can add a limited headroom top-up to cover first 3 months but need to adjust effective unit pricing.

I’ve attached a draft SOW + a simple term sheet (spreadsheet) for numbers. If useful, can set up a 30-min pricing walkthrough with Rishi to go line-by-line.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Nimbus_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW stub), pricing-term-sheet-18mo.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Sam Patel <sam.p@nimbus.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellie Rogers <ellie.procurement@nimbus.ai>
Date: 2026-10-29T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: prepay + ramp credits — quick ask and options

Hi Laura — thanks, this is helpful. A few constraints from our side:
- Cash flow: we can stretch to a 12-month prepay but not a large multi-year capex right now.
- We need predictable monthly burn after month 3. Launch spikes are a concern (first 6–8 weeks).
- Procurement prefers a single PO with Net30; split payments are possible but add cycle time.

If we did 12 months, we’d ask for:
1) Higher launch credits (70% for first 2 months) to absorb spikes
2) A small rollover credit pool that can be used within 6 months if unused
3) A modest discount (5%) applied as a bill credit if monthly usage averages above X tokens for 3 consecutive months.

I’m looping Ellie on procurement to confirm PO/tax terms. Can you or Rishi confirm whether rollover credits are feasible and how they affect effective ARR calculations?

—Sam
Head of Engineering, Nimbus Labs
sam.p@nimbus.ai

Subject: Re: Proposal: prepay + ramp credits — quick ask and options

Sam — good notes. Looping Rishi to confirm the mechanics. Quick answers:
- Rollover credits: we can offer a limited 6-month rollover on unused launch credits up to 20% of the initial launch pool. Beyond that, credits expire.
- Launch credit magnitude can be increased for a 12-month prepay, but it will reduce nominal coverage of committed value (i.e., a larger upfront credit pool is material to our finance model).
- The 5% bill credit tied to sustained usage is something we can do as a structured volume rebate (requires milestone in SOW).

Rishi — can you propose a clean 12mo prepay structure that gives Nimbus the higher short-term headroom they asked for while keeping Redwood’s unit economics intact? I’d prefer a single PO Net30 if procurement is happy with that.

Thanks,
Laura

Subject: Re: Proposal: prepay + ramp credits — 12mo-conservative and 18mo-split options

Thanks for the context. I ran the numbers and propose two executable options targeted at your constraints. Key assumptions: launch peak covered = first 60 days; rollover cap = 20% transfer; Net30 PO.

Proposal (executable):
Option 1 — 12mo Accelerated (preferred for Nimbus cash profile)
- $125,000 prepay at signing (covers months 1–12).
- Launch credit pool = credits equivalent to $50k (70% effective coverage for month 1–2), 6-month rollover up to 20% of that pool.
- Sustained-usage rebate: 5% bill credit after 3 consecutive months > threshold T (threshold T set in SOW).
- No term discount.
- Redwood adds a one-time "launch support" waiver (waive onboarding fees up to $6k).

Option 2 — 18mo Split-Prepay (best for unit economics + discount)
- $200,000 total commitment; payable 60/40 (signing / 6 months) or full upfront if preferred.
- 40% launch credits in months 1–3, 12% term discount applied month 13–18 pricing.
- Rollover up to 3 months beyond launch window (limited).

Operational notes: credits are token-level credits applied before billing; finance treats credits as bill credits not revenue reductions for the committed amount (we will include language in SOW). If Ellie confirms Net30 PO we can push contract for legal review and DocuSign.

Sam — let me know which path you prefer. If 12mo Accelerated, we can turn the SOW into an executable in 48 hours.

—Rishi
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
